why: Clothing shops need size/color matrix, variants, seasonal collections, markdowns and exchange rules. The key is the variant matrix and markdown tracking.
operator: The clothing shop owner manages a variant-heavy inventory of apparel, seasonal collections and markdowns. Their day is receiving new collections, pricing per variant and tracking exchanges.
entities: Shop (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)

Product (id, shopId, sku, nameAr, nameEn, category (tops/ bottoms/dresses/accessories), season, colorAr, colorEn, sizeAr, sizeEn, unitPricePiasters, costPiasters, taxRate, condition (new/used), stockQty, status, locationShelf)
Variant (id, productId, colorId, sizeId, skuSuffix, priceDeltaPiasters, isDefault, stockQty)
Customer (id, shopId, name, phone, whatsAppOptIn, purchaseHistoryCount, totalSpentPiasters)
Order (id, shopId, customerId, lines with productId variantId, quantity, unitPricePiasters, discountPiasters, serviceChargePiasters, totalPiasters, paymentStatus, status, createdAt, closedAt)
Staff (id, shopId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: No : clothing retail carries no stock or expiry (condition indicates wear, not expiry)
expiry: Not applicable. Products have condition states not expiry dates
special: The core structures are the product variant matrix (color + size per SKU), the markdown tracker and the exchange log. Variant tracking per color/size is the key differentiator from regular retail.
screens: Product catalogue: grid of items with name, price, color badge, size badge, condition (new/used), availability
Product detail: full info, all color/size variants, stock per variant, markdown percentage, exchange policy
Variant manager: add/edit variant (color, size, price delta, default flag, stock qty). Done when variant is saved and linked to product.
Markdown tracker: set markdown % per product per period, track original price vs discounted price, apply at till
Exchange log: record exchange reason (size/color/defect), update stock, issue refund note
Customer profile: purchase history, total spent, notes, opt-in status
Cash register: scan SKU or variant, apply markdown/discount, tender payment, print receipt
Staff shift: clock in/out, customer load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : inventory, pricing, markdowns, exchanges, reports, billing
Sales rep: manage products, create variants, apply markdowns, handle exchanges
Cashier: scan items, apply markdown/discount, tender payment, print receipt
Stock clerk: receive shipments, update stock, create variants, process exchanges
reports: Sales by day and hour: revenue per period, peak hours
Variant performance: which color/size combinations sell most, revenue per variant per period
Markdown effectiveness: original price vs discounted price per period, sell-through rate at discount
Exchange volume: exchanges per period, reasons, refund amount per period
Customer repeat rate: visit count per customer, total spent per customer, re-book rate
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and exchange notes
WhatsApp deep link for customer notifications (exchange ready, markdown alerts)
Email for invoice and exchange confirmation (opt-in)
onboarding: Shop basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial inventory: the starting product list with SKU, colors, sizes, prices and condition
Product categories: tops, bottoms, dresses, accessories, seasonal collections
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: receive first collection, list first products, first customer sale with variant selection
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the variant matrix and role templates.

tasks.title: Add product catalogue with color/size badges
tasks.brief: Build the product catalogue: grid of items with name, price, color badge, size badge, condition (new/used), availability. Done when the catalogue loads and displays items with correct variant badges.
tasks.done: When product catalogue displays live data with variant badges

tasks.title: Add variant manager
tasks.brief: Build the variant screen: add/edit variant (color, size, price delta, default flag, stock qty). Done when the variant is saved and linked to the product and stock updates correctly.
tasks.done: When variant manager works and links variant to product with stock update

tasks.title: Add markdown tracker
tasks.brief: Build the markdown screen: set markdown % per product per period, track original price vs discounted price, apply at till. Done when the markdown is saved and the till applies the discount correctly.
tasks.done: When markdown tracker works end-to-end with discount application at till

tasks.title: Add exchange log
tasks.brief: Build the exchange screen: record exchange reason (size/color/defect), update stock, issue refund note. Done when the exchange is saved and stock updates correctly and note is issued.
tasks.done: When exchange log works end-to-end with stock update and refund note

tasks.title: Add customer profile with purchase history
tasks.brief: Build the customer profile: purchase history, total spent, notes, opt-in status. Done when the profile saves and displays correct data.
tasks.done: When customer profile works and displays live data

tasks.title: Add cash register with variant scanning and markdown
tasks.brief: Build the cash register: scan SKU or variant, apply markdown/discount, tender payment, print receipt. Done when the sale records variant and markdown correctly and receipt prints.
tasks.done: When cash register works end-to-end with variant scanning and markdown

tasks.title: Add variant performance report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing which color/size combinations sell most and revenue per variant per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When variant performance report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add markdown effectiveness report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing original price vs discounted price per period and sell-through rate at discount. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When markdown effectiveness report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add exchange volume report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing exchanges per period, reasons, refund amount per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When exchange volume report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial clothing shop setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: shop basics, initial inventory, product categories with variant flag, staff addition. Done when the flow completes and the shop appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and shop is created

risks: Encryption key loss makes product and order records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Markdown without clear criteria can lead to revenue loss and customer disputes
Exchange descriptions that violate consumer protection law on refunds
